mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 52 degrees under clear skies by Badger Ridge Middle School. The Waning Gibbous moon will be visible, and you can spot the International Space Station passing tonight as it rises near Verona High School and travels toward Fitchburg, reaching halfway up the sky.

In city business, the 2027 spring election will feature all four Aldermanic district seats on the ballot, and candidates must submit their paperwork by January 5. Additionally, the city is reminding residents that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15.

There is plenty to do with The Crafty Fair happening today at ART House 360, live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's also taking place today, plus trivia events scheduled throughout early December.
In a noteworthy call from November 6, Verona Fire personnel had to assist when a woman was found passed out in a vehicle, which resulted in her arrest for O W I.
Today is a great day to stop by for the Mint Cookie flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
